title: Social Life : Forms and Dynamics
sources_used: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Give one example of a personal problem that can be better understood using sociological imagination.
questions.solution_html:
• Sociological Imagination Example: Unemployment—seen not as personal
  • failure but linked to economic structure. /[CO1]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Discuss two major social problems that emerged during the Industrial Revolution and how they attracted the attention of early sociologists.
questions.solution_html:
• Industrial Revolution Problems: Urban poverty and child labour; early
  • sociologists studied their social causes. /[CO1]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Examine the role of individualism in modern social life.
questions.solution_html:
• Individualism in Modern Life: Encourages self-expression but weakens
  • traditional community ties. /[CO2]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Briefly explain the term “historical materialism”?
questions.solution_html:
• Historical Materialism: Marx’s concept that material conditions and economic
  • base determine social structure. /[CO2]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Explain one key difference between class structure in urban areas and social structure in tribal areas.
questions.solution_html:
• Class vs. Tribal Structure: Urban areas—economic class hierarchy; tribal areas
  • —kinship-based egalitarianism. /[CO3]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Briefly describe the role of women’s organizations in Kerala in addressing gender-based issues in the 21st century.
questions.solution_html:
• Women’s Organisations in Kerala: Kudumbashree and Vanitha Commission
  • promote gender justice. /[CO3]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Explain in your own words what is meant by 'lived culture'.
questions.solution_html:
• Lived Culture: Everyday practices through which people experience and
  • reproduce culture. /[CO4]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Describe how habitus influences individual behaviour.
questions.solution_html:
• Habitus: Bourdieu’s concept of internalized dispositions shaping social
  • behaviour. /[CO4]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Distinguish between ascribed and achieved status with one example of each.
questions.solution_html:
• Ascribed vs. Achieved Status: Birth-based (ascribed)—caste; merit-based
  • (achieved)—profession. /[CO1]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Describe the focus of phenomenology in understanding social reality.
questions.solution_html:
• Phenomenology: Focuses on subjective meanings individuals attach to
  • experiences. /[CO2]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Elucidate on the role Panchayati Raj Institutions play in the development of rural areas?
questions.solution_html:
• Panchayati Raj Role: Decentralizes power; enables local participation and
  • development. /[CO3]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Describe how the Enlightenment emphasis on science and rationality contributed to the emergence of the social sciences.
questions.solution_html:
• Enlightenment’s Role: Promoted rationality and empirical inquiry, paving way
  • for sociology. /[CO1]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Briefly explain the 'presentation of self' in social life by Erving Goffman
questions.solution_html:
• Goffman’s Presentation of Self: Individuals perform roles to manage
  • impressions in social interaction. /[CO2]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Discuss the significance of language in shaping Indian identity after independence.
questions.solution_html:
• Language and Identity: Unites diverse groups; post-independence India used
  • language to define states and identity. /[CO3]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Explain how popular culture can reflect social values or norms.
questions.solution_html:
• Popular Culture: Reflects and reinforces social values through films, media, and
  • fashion. /[CO4]
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Discuss the impact of the French Revolution on the development of sociological thought. [2x13 = 26]
questions.solution_html:
• French Revolution Impact: Promoted liberty and equality, influencing
  • sociological thought on social change. /[CO1]
